scope: Static listening-kit integrity and browser rendering; no additional inference or quality scoring.

browser_check.visual_inspection: Desktop screenshots inspected: heading and scope; French and Spanish side-by-side comparisons; Latvian comparison and attribution footer. No visible clipping or overlapping text.
browser_check.audio_controls: Clicked play for each of the three recordings and observed the pause control; all three reported their expected duration. This is playback/UI verification, not a native-language listening judgment.

factual_text_differences.fr_fr: Reference contains a non-breaking space after the comma before en particulier; output uses an ordinary space. No other string difference.
factual_text_differences.es_419: Reference contains a comma after sentido; output omits that comma.
factual_text_differences.lv_lv: Reference has devis and citus; actual prediction has devas and citas. These observations compare the displayed strings and do not assert linguistic correctness.
